criteria: The app is built with React (using Vite or Create React App) and has at least 5 distinct, named components — not everything in App.jsx
The app is the HW07 public API mini-app rebuilt in React — it fetches the same data and shows loading, success, and error states
A 'favorites' feature is implemented using React component state (useState) — no external state management library
Lists of items are rendered using .map() with a unique key prop on each element
The app is deployed on GitHub Pages using the gh-pages npm package or equivalent
